classification.difficultyReason: Use the central-angle fraction of a circle, then substitute the requested approximation.

spec.description: Unshaded 60-degree sector with centre O, a centre dot, an upper radius rising right and a lower radius sloping slightly down right, labelled 7 cm.
spec.mathematics: Both straight sides have length 7 cm and enclose 60 degrees.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the area of the sector with radius $7\text{ cm}$ that contains an angle of $60^\circ$. Leave your answer in terms of $\pi$.

answer.worked:
The sector is $\frac{60}{360}=\frac16$ of a full circle.

$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac{60}{360}\pi r^2\\A&=\frac16\pi\times7^2\\A&=\frac{49\pi}{6}\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Now use $\pi\approx\frac{22}{7}$ to find the approximate value of the area in part a.
